column1: # Upstream literals the Linux patches depend on, with the count each has in
# the pristine bundle. scripts/check-upstream-tripwires.sh runs every line
# over an unpatched .webpack/ tree (build-linux.sh step 3 before the first
# patch; tests/test-patch-stage.sh; the nightly bump pre-check), so drift in
# upstream's own code fails by name before an anchor can miss. Keep counts
# structural (a log line, a preload name, a single call shape), never a
# bundle-wide total that moves for benign reasons.
#   patch     the scripts/patches/<patch>.sh the line belongs to, or
#             `upstream` for a fact no single patch owns
#   file      main | renderer/<name> | renderer/* (every renderer index.js
#             that reads platform?.isWindows, like the step 3 driver)
#   label     what the literal is, for the report
#   pattern   the literal or regex; no tabs
